The bowl is a stainless steel mixing bowl, roughly 25-30 cm across. It holds diced cooked chicken breast pieces spread over a patch about 12 cm wide. They are mostly one layer deep, with a few pieces stacked. Each piece is about 2 cm, so roughly 3-4 g each. I count about 45 pieces, which gives about 150 g.
